1.consolidated_definition: Hierba perenne de hasta 60 cm de altura, pubescente, simple o poco ramificada, con tallo hojoso y hojas alternas, de lanceoladas a oblongas, y flores blanco brillante. (Campanulaceae; Hippobroma longiflora).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial herb reaching up to 60 cm in height, pubescent, simple or slightly branched, with leafy stem and alternate lanceolate to oblong leaves, and bright white flowers. (Campanulaceae; Hippobroma longiflora).
